about: Talmud Law, PLLC keeps offices on Main Street in Williamsville and on Gleed Avenue in East Aurora, names three attorneys, and is the only firm in this ranking that presents adoption first: its front door offers a Buffalo adoption attorney and an Erie County private family lawyer, and it publishes a page on gestational surrogacy representation.

30 reviews at 3.7. It describes four routes through a case, explains five stages, and names the state and American bar associations. Its site scores 89 out of 100, second only to Hawthorne & Vesper here. It publishes no rate, no retainer figure and no flat fee.
